lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial slits, exhibiting a higher density near the pectoral fin base with increasing spatial divergence posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs to form a distinct lattice-like arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges running horizontally across the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance dorsal highlights to low-luminance ventral shadows.
